rule: One row per player per game. Minutes, points, rebounds and assists are read from the official gamebook row; a row is stored only when it assembles into 16 numeric cells, otherwise it is recorded in `problems` and excluded. Team point totals and minute totals are asserted against the gamebook's own team line. Players who appear only on the gamebook's Inactive line are stored as played:false rows with the printed reason (additive over the 2026-11-16 document).

minutes_check.note: Each player's MM:SS is rounded to the second by the document, so a team's per-player minutes need not sum to exactly 240:00. The tolerance is 5 s per team; the residual is published rather than corrected.
